subject.title: Feature Request: Image batching / media group buffering at gateway layer

question: Should LINE and other channels without native grouping metadata get opt-in same-sender media batching, a broader shared channel contract, or no heuristic media batching support?
rationale: The remaining gap requires choosing public config semantics, default latency, batching keys, and plugin-vs-shared ownership for a heuristic platform with no reliable album id.

options.title: Approve LINE opt-in batching
options.body: Add a conservative LINE plugin option that batches only downloadable media from the same account, conversation, and sender with documented timer and flush behavior.

options.title: Design shared channel contract first
options.body: Define a reusable media-aware channel SDK/core contract before changing LINE, accepting broader review and compatibility work.

options.title: Document unsupported heuristic batching
options.body: Keep native Telegram album buffering only and document that channels without grouping metadata dispatch media events individually.

recommendation.title: Approve LINE opt-in batching
recommendation.body: Add a conservative LINE plugin option that batches only downloadable media from the same account, conversation, and sender with documented timer and flush behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest overlap across shared debounce policy, LINE media handling, and config/product-boundary history.
